hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f || exit 0; case "$f" in *src/data/werke.ts|*docs/decision-log.md|*docs/audits/*|*src/data/post/ledger.json|*src/data/begegnungen/register.json|*src/data/attention/export.json|*/meta.json) root=$(cd "$(dirname "$f")" 2>/dev/null && git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ -d "$root/node_modules" ] || exit 0; (cd "$root" && npm run --silent graph:build >/dev/null 2>&1) || exit 0; echo '{"systemMessage":"graph: re-derived from the records"}' ;; esac; }
